name: upstream-emit-reference
description: Pinned svelte2tsx + svelte used by scripts/gen-upstream-emit.mjs to write the upstream reference emit for the emit-snapshot samples. svelte2tsx must equal the language-tools submodule's packages/svelte2tsx version; the generator refuses to run otherwise. `svelte4` is the compiler a sample whose workspace installs Svelte 4 is generated with, as svelte-check would load that project's own compiler.
